newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil weak.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil weak.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel was weak on Tuesday under the weight of good avails and poor demand, traders said.
Dealers saw the market at close to $135 fob NWE after trades on Monday at $135.50 fob Scandinavia and $142.25 cif Lavera.

E-4 markets were thin and cargoes were assessed around m/m/m +$2/4 cif NWE. One cargo, said an M-40 with viscosity close to that of an E-4, was heard traded on Monday at m/m/m flat. More E-4 cargoes were seen available late in January than early.
One trader was heard offering a high water M40/M100 cargo at a $3.50 discount to the mean/mean/mean.
